source.normalization: Unified clean-engine event semantics for this audit case

notes.event_definition: Construct valid overtake events only from lap_positions rows where lap_type = 'Race'. Lap 1 uses positive results.grid values as the previous state; grid = 0 is not a normal grid slot. Later laps use the previous Race lap. Retirement lap_positions rows do not create events.
notes.classification: Apply R, then P, then S, then T. R uses retirements as a label on an already valid event. P uses same-lap or previous-lap pit_stops with no time-gap threshold.
notes.part_a: Unified clean-engine gold for pit-data races across all eligible race laps.
notes.part_b: Unified clean-engine gold for all races on event laps 1 through 5 under the positive-grid lap-1 semantics.
notes.part_c: Unified clean-engine hard-gated track-only driver list for all races and all eligible race laps.
